newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-PaineWebber sees higher Danish '97 GDP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-PaineWebber sees higher Danish '97 GDP.

text.p: In its latest survey U.K. investment bank PaineWebber on Monday raised its expectations for Denmark's 1997 GDP (gross domestic product) growth to 2.7 percent from 2.3 percent in its last forecast in December 1996.
At the same time it lowered its estimate for the currrent account surplus to 6.3 billion crowns from 10.2 billion crowns, leaving its inflation forecast for this year at an unchanged 2.5 percent.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in December foresaw 2.9 percent GDP growth, 2.3 percent inflation, 8.0 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 13.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
